# Law.Resource.Org

> Law is the operating system of society—Law.Resource.Org provides public access to legal codes, government transparency tools, and building standards to make the law transparent and accessible to all.

Law.Resource.Org, led by Carl Malamud and Public.Resource.Org, champions open legal access by digitizing and distributing US government legal materials, building codes, safety standards, and historical legal references. The site partners with initiatives like Law.Gov and Code for America to advance government transparency and civic engagement through freely accessible legal databases.

## Key Topics

- Government Transparency
- Legal Access
- Open Law
- Public Codes

## Core Mission & Initiatives

- [Law.Resource.Org Homepage](https://law.resource.org/index.html): Homepage introducing law.resource.org's mission for public legal access and transparency
- [Law.Gov: America's Operating System, Open Source](https://law.resource.org/index.law.gov.html): Law.Gov initiative for open-source US legal materials and government data distribution

## Legal & Historical References

- [12 Tables of Codes](https://law.resource.org/pub/12tables.html): Historical legal reference: Twelve Tables of Law from Roman Republic with public access

## Public Safety & Building Standards

- [Public Safety Standards of India](https://law.resource.org/pub/in/manifest.in.html): Directory of Indian public safety standards from Bureau of Indian Standards
